brief: Indian markets reopen after the holiday with Sensex rallying over 1,000 points in the pre-market session and Nifty above 25,650. Overseas, Wall Street ended lower and Asian stocks slid as AI jitters resurfaced and fresh US tariff plans weighed on sentiment.
